_monitoring_mandate.SILENCE_RULE_READ_THIS_BEFORE_PUSHING: At ~26 runs/day, an un-deduped mandate turns into 26 notifications a day and Ryan stops reading them -- which destroys the mandate's whole purpose. Before pushing, check last_notified_trigger: if the SAME trigger is still the live one and nothing material has changed, DO NOT notify again -- update the timestamp and mark and stay silent. Re-notify only when a DIFFERENT trigger fires, a fired trigger un-fires, or the recommendation itself changes. A position quietly working is not news; the journal and the EOD report already carry it.
_monitoring_mandate.WHAT_A_RECOMMENDATION_MUST_CONTAIN: Never send a bare 'consider selling'. _LEGGING_TESTED_AND_BLOCKED.the_mechanism: A spread's risk offset exists ONLY INSIDE a multi-leg order. Sent alone, leg two is not 'the short leg of a spread' -- the broker cannot know a long 695P is meant to cover it -- so it is margined STANDALONE as a cash-secured put and demands the entire strike in collateral. Legging destroys the exact property that makes a vertical capital-efficient. A legged CALL spread is worse: a standalone short call is NAKED (cash.infinite=true), banned outright at any level.

Long-first ordering prevents a naked short; it does NOT prevent the orphan.

_MULTICONTRACT_SIZING_FINDING.why_it_is_wrong_measured_not_modelled: Spread as a percentage of mid is a PER-CONTRACT property, entirely independent of quantity. TEN TLT 2026-09-18 84C = $595.00, dead centre of the CORE band, at 1.68% of mid, delta 0.415, OI 51,155, with a 546 x 784 book that absorbs the size without strain. _MULTICONTRACT_SIZING_FINDING.what_it_opens: The liquid low-priced ETF universe (TLT, XLP, XLF, XLU, XLE and peers) is available to BOTH tracks and has never been hunted. It matters most on exactly the days that keep stalling this desk: when index and mega-cap boards are blocked by one single-name earnings print, these instruments are uncorrelated with it and quote far tighter than the equity report's mid-cap screen -- 1.68% of mid today against that screen's 12.6-52%.
_MULTICONTRACT_SIZING_FINDING.the_honest_limits: Three, so no future run over-reads this. (1) It supplies NO thesis -- this run measured the chain and still declined the trade. (2) Per-contract commissions scale with quantity where they apply, so a 10-lot pays ten times any per-contract fee even though the spread ratio is unchanged; check the fee line in review_option_order before sizing large lots.
